Hi Sergio —

I wasn't seeing the calendar invite populate for our group calendar. When I click the join link in the invite that did come through, FinExt gets a permissions error: "You don't have permission to join this meeting" (we're on an org SSO and sometimes Zoom roles/organizer mismatch causes this).

Screenshot attached as join-error.png (sent separately). Can we either:
- reissue the invite as a new organizer from your side, or
- provide a fallback Meet link we can try quickly?

If it's easier to move, our team is open Friday 6/27 11:00-12:30 PT or Tuesday 7/1 9:00-11:00 PT.

Sorry about the friction, and thanks for the heads up. I suspect the organizer field in the original invite was set from a shared account which can trigger SSO/role checks. Immediate workaround while we reissue: I'm dropping a Meet fallback below you can try now (no sign-in required):
https://meet.google.com/xyz-demo-fallback

If that doesn't work, Ben can send a fresh Zoom invite with explicit passcode and disable the host-only join restriction. Proposed reschedule windows if you'd rather move:
- Fri 2027-06-27 11:00am PT
- Tue 2027-07-01 9:30am PT
- Wed 2027-07-02 10:00am PT

Will stand by — appreciate the patience.

Sergio
